lines: One day in Gosha Village――
In the mornings, the same song was always playing in the living room of a man's house.
Symphony No. 9 in D Major.
A symphony from Gustav Mahler's final years, and, perhaps reflecting his own life having neared its end, the whole piece was coloured by death.
It was a masterpiece with an interesting history behind it, which, despite it being known as his magnum opus, Mahler had never been able to perform himself, owing to his death.
While listening to that parting song, which was unfitting for the start of the day, the man was having the same breakfast as always.
Two eggs' worth of scrambled eggs. Two strips of crispy bacon, and two cherry tomatoes.
The toast was divided into neat triangles, strawberry jam on one, marmalade on the other.
The coffee was an acidic-tasting mocha cinnamon roast, black.
He ate each one of those separately. At no point did he ever put two things in his mouth at once.
Having eaten his scrambled eggs, the man suddenly opened a notebook and entered something.
Salt +2 grams. Pepper -0.5 grams. Heat -10 seconds.
His face when he made that memo was calmness itself.
And then, once he completed his meal and finished drinking his second cup of coffee, right on schedule,
The man washed the dishes with precise movements, brushed his teeth, and left the house.
There was no need to even look at the clock. It was the same time as always.
「This is a pleasant morning.」
A morning no different from usual.
However, perhaps because he had had a feeling it would be a 『good day』, the man was humming as he walked.
His destination was Gosha Academy.
Having reached the front of Inageya, the man glanced inside the shop, like usual.
The ex-Taimanin proprietress was positioned neatly in her usual place, like a decoration.
He had never even once used the store, but that was an important morning sight for him.
He nodded, and was about to head to the school.
It was then that an anomaly occurred.
Sakura
「Outtatheway outtatheway outtathewaaaayyyy～～!!!」
A grating voice.
A woman who was not supposed to be in this place at this time.
Igawa Sakura.
That person had appeared all of a sudden.
Sakura
「Fugyahh!!」
「Uguhhh!!」
Sakura and the man had collided head-on in spectacular fashion.
Although they had both avoided falling on their backsides, this was an unthinkable irregularity.
Sakura
「Owowow...... You okay?!」
Sakura
「Say, it feels like I've seen you somewhere......」
Saitou Hanjirou
「I'm Saitou...... Miss. I teach Contemporary Social Studies.」
Saitou Hanjirou answered Sakura, who stared at him blankly.
Sakura
「Oh, right, Satou-sensei, right? Morning!」
Saitou Hanjirou
「It's Saitou. Good morning......」
Saitou Hanjirou
「What seems to be the matter? Sakura-sensei is always on the brink of tardiness. It's still too early for you to be panicking.」
Sakura
「Nahaha! Well, y'see, I forgot that Onee-chan asked me to unlock the school gates this morning.」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Which would mean that the students doing club activities and the teachers who arrive early will be inconvenienced, I take it......」
Most importantly, now Saitou himself was.
The rhythm of his pleasant morning was ruined thanks to this.
Sakura
「Right! That's why I'm rushing! Bye, Satou-sensei! See you at school!」
Sakura hurriedly raced down the road to Gosha Academy, with swiftness befitting her alias of “The Almighty Taimanin's Sister”.
Saitou Hanjirou
「It's Saitou. Honestly. Unlike her distinguished older sister, she hasn't even a shred of refinement, has she?」
Saitou used his hand to brush off the area where he had collided with her, and was about to forget about the incident just now and set forth, when
Saitou Hanjirou
He suddenly sensed that something was off.
He put his hand in the pocket of his suit, and took out his favourite pocketwatch.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Shit.........! That careless bitch!!」
Lo and behold, a crack had formed in the glass part of the pocketwatch from the impact of having been bumped into.
His feeling that this was going to be a 『good day』.
All that had completely evaporated.
Kiiin konnn kaaan konnn♪
The end-of-school chime rang.
Today was another tranquil day.
If he didn't count the incident in the morning, which he didn't even want to remember.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Well then, I'll be off now.」
Saitou had finished his desk work, and stood from his seat in the Social Studies backroom.
Colleague
「Oh, Saitou-sensei. You're leaving early today, then?」
Checking the clock, a coworker of his made a puzzled-looking expression.
Saitou, who always came to work and departed at a regular time, never left school this early.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Yes. I've got something to take care of in Maesaki City.」
Colleague
「Would that be a date, by any chance?」
Saitou Hanjirou
「It is an exercise in correcting this blunder of a day.」
Colleague
Saitou Hanjirou
「Pardon me for leaving ahead of you.」
Colleague
「Uh, not at all...... Thanks for the hard work.」
Saitou Hanjirou
「And you.」
While exchanging pleasantries with the other teacher, he left the room at a brisk pace.
A few hours later.
Saitou was in Maesaki, the closest regional city to Gosha Village.
That said, it still took about three hours by train and bus.
He had come to an old watch shop he knew in this city, to ask them to repair his pocketwatch.
He had been told it would take two weeks for a repair.
As it was just the right time for its regular triennial overhaul, he had included that as well, and left the watch with them.
Thinking of it not as Sakura having broken his watch, but this being its usual overhaul soothed Saitou's mind just a little.
And now, he was enjoying a dark-roast mandheling at the café that he always stopped by when he came to this town.
Normally he had it black, but at this place, it was Saitou's preference to add milk and sugar.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Today was a terrible day, but......」
It wasn't bad to enjoy this mellow flavour on the way home from work.
If he went home once he finished drinking this, he would probably be able to get back to Gosha before evening fell.
Man
「Yo, I got a little somethin' to talk to you about.」
An unfamiliar man had sat down in front of him.
He was the type of fellow that Saitou disliked the most, who, both in appearance and speaking style, seemed like he was advertising his stupidity to the whole world.
Saitou Hanjirou
Naturally, Saitou ignored him, and was about to stand up, when the man suddenly stuck out his menacing-looking face.
Man
「Oi oi, I said I got something to talk about!」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Aren't you mistaking me for someone?」
Man
「Nah, there's no mistake. You're Saitou Hanjirou, yeah?」
Saitou Hanjirou
Having his name guessed correctly all of a sudden by the unfamiliar hoodlum, he knit his brows slightly.
Man
「Don't be so defensive. Sit down. I'm just the messenger.」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Messenger, you say?」
Man
「Yeah, I'm an envoy from “Cabinet Intelligence”.」
The man said, in a voice that only Saitou would be able to hear.
Saitou Hanjirou
Once Saitou heard that, he was naturally obligated to comply.
While nonchalantly surveying his surroundings, he lowered his hips, which had started to rise, back down.
Man
「A matcha frappuccino, with fresh fruit ricotta pancakes. And can I add ice cream?」
Employee
「Yes, you can choose add-ons from here.」
Man
「This salted caramel ice cream, then.」
Employee
「Certainly, sir.」
Ignoring Saitou, who had reseated himself, the man was making an order that sounded like the embodiment of sweetness.
Saitou Hanjirou
「What business does an envoy from Cabinet Intelligence have with me?」
The man drank a sip of the liquid in his cup, and said
Igawa Kageomi
「Heh heh, finally started to feel like hearing me out? I'll start by introducing myself. I'm Igawa Kageomi.」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Igawa, you say?」
Saitou's vigilance rose again.
Needless to say, that name had a significant meaning for a person from Gosha.
Igawa Kageomi
「I'm a distant relative of the “Almighty Taimanin”. But I sided with the Elders, and post-banishment, I'm working for the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office, like this.」
The man, who had given his name as Igawa Kageomi, said, in a “no big deal” manner.
Saitou Hanjirou
「State your business.」
Igawa Kageomi
「Why did you kill our collaborator?」
Saitou Hanjirou
Igawa Kageomi
「Didn't you hear me? I'll say it once again. Why did you kill our collaborator, Numazu?」
Numazu Hikoshirou was a man who had worked as custodian at Gosha Academy, and a Mud Escape Art user.
Certainly, Saitou was the one who had eliminated him.
Igawa Kageomi
「Does the fact that you killed Numazu mean that you're hostile to Cabinet Intelligence?」
Saitou Hanjirou
「I am neither friend nor foe. I simply removed Numazu because he got in my way.」
Igawa Kageomi
「The Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office believed that we had formed an alliance with you through Numazu.」
Saitou Hanjirou
「That's a selfish interpretation. I'm fine enough on my own.」
Igawa Kageomi
「So in other words, you intend to betray our alliance?」
Saitou Hanjirou
「I never formed any such alliance from the start. I don't care what you might have heard from Numazu, however.」
Igawa Kageomi
「Simple. The order I've received is simple. If you've betrayed us, then I kill you. That's all.」
A murderous air slowly spread out between Saitou and Kageomi.
An explosive situation―――But,
Employee
「Thank you for waiting. Here's your matcha frappuccino, with fresh fruit ricotta pancakes. Topped with salted caramel ice cream.」
Their server, who had nothing to do with that murderous air, had come along. A pile of sweets were on his tray. It felt like one would get indigestion, just looking at them.
Igawa Kageomi
「Oh, thank you.」
Kageomi, surprisingly, began to eat them like they were delicious, with the mouth that had just said that he was going to kill Saitou.
Igawa Kageomi
「Aren'tcha gonna eat anything? The pancakes here are excellent, y'know.」
Saitou Hanjirou
While feeling a fair amount of irritation, Saitou said
Saitou Hanjirou
「Are you trying to intimidate me? You'd do best to stop that.」
Igawa Kageomi
「I'm the gofer. So I don't make the complicated decisions. This is the last question. Have you betrayed us?」
Kageomi asked, like he didn't care either way, while swirling around the fork that he held in his hand.
Saitou Hanjirou
「I never intended to form an alliance with the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office.」
Igawa Kageomi
「Oi oi, giving a complicated answer... Ya didn't make an alliance, but you did kill Cabinet Intelligence's collaborator? So basically, you did violate the alliance, then?」
He grumbled to himself, while beginning to prod the sweets on the plate like this was a chore.
Saitou Hanjirou
「What are you rambling about? If you make me angry, you'll come to regret it.」
Kageomi didn't answer.
In which case, there was no need to engage with him anymore.
Saitou stood up from his seat.
Saitou Hanjirou
He left the café, and went from the main street into a back alley.
He now had one more thing to do before he went home, but it was no big deal.
He would get through it quickly, and then return home as planned.
And then, a few minutes later―――
Agent
A woman in a completely black jumpsuit had blocked his path.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Are you pursuing me for Igawa Kageomi?」
He asked, even though he didn't need to.
The woman was silent.
Saitou Hanjirou
「From behind as well, hmm?」
When he looked back due to the presence of someone,
Agent
Assassin
A similarly-dressed woman and another person, a man in black, were approaching.
The man was hiding his face with a mask, but he was not Igawa Kageomi, from before. His build was different.
Saitou was surrounded by the trio, who seemed to be that man's subordinates.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Will Igawa Kageomi not be coming? Is he still in that café?」
Agents
Assassin
The assassins did not respond.
They just intensified their bloodthirst, and slowly, but steadily approached him.
Saitou Hanjirou
「You're under the misapprehension that you've cornered me, aren't you?」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Not so. I lured you into a place that was out of sight. I am always the one doing the hunting!!!」
The assassins all pounced simultaneously.
